flags.name: BRL / BROCE / SBCH
flags.issue: DIAGNOSIS CHANGED — this is a PARSER defect, not code reuse, and no longer needs the supplier. The FFT catalogue shows each code is one product: BROCE is "BROCCOLINI (BUNCH)" at $3.17, matching our invoices to the cent; BRL is "BROCCOLINI (BOX)"; SBCH is "Shallot" at $2.86/bunch against our $2.65. FFT does not list radicchio at all. So the SECOND name on each code — 'Radiccio' on BRL, 'Cocktail (Box)' on BROCE, 'Red Long' on SBCH — is a description stitched from the WRONG neighbouring row, the same class as MKB500PUNN. Cost is unaffected (pack comes from raw_uom); it is the names that are wrong.
flags.suggested_fix: Fix the FFT description stitch so it cannot take a neighbouring line's text. No supplier call needed.
